about: Query builder cases every adapter of the framework must pass. `sql` is the MySQL form; the PostgreSQL form is the same with ? numbered $1, $2, ... and backticks as double quotes. Each case replays `chain` on `model` and compares the generated SQL and params exactly. `whereHas` / `whereNotHas` take an object of conditions, or a nested chain (list of steps) for the related model. The chain ends with toSQL (default) or withJoin.

cases.name: where calls chain with AND
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE `enable` IN (?) AND `id` IN (?, ?)

cases.name: several columns in one where come out in column-name order
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM book_stocks WHERE `id` IN (?, ?) AND `publish` IN (?)

cases.name: where with reset drops earlier conditions
whereHas with conditions and with a nested chain
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM book_stocks WHERE `publish` IN (?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM books AS `books__1` WHERE `books__1`.`id` = `book_stocks`.`book_id` AND (`public_listing` IN (?))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products AS `products__1` WHERE `products__1`.`id` = `book_stocks`.`product_id` AND (`enable` IN (?)))

cases.name: nested whereHas refers to the inner alias
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM books WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM book_stocks AS `book_stocks__1` WHERE `book_stocks__1`.`book_id` = `books`.`id` AND (`publish` IN (?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products AS `products__2` WHERE `products__2`.`id` = `book_stocks__1`.`product_id` AND (`enable` IN (?)))))

cases.name: a relation to the same table is aliased
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM categories WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories AS `categories__1` WHERE `categories__1`.`id` = `categories`.`category_id` AND (`enable` IN (?)))

cases.name: whereNotHas without conditions, then orderBy
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM books WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM book_stocks AS `book_stocks__1` WHERE `book_stocks__1`.`book_id` = `books`.`id`) ORDER BY `id` DESC

cases.name: limit and offset
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY `name` ASC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20

cases.name: withJoin uses the chain
cases.sql: SELECT `book_stocks`.`id` AS `id`, `book_stocks`.`publish` AS `publish`, `r_product`.`id` AS `product__id`, `r_product`.`name` AS `product__name`, `r_product`.`enable` AS `product__enable` FROM book_stocks `book_stocks` LEFT JOIN products `r_product` ON `book_stocks`.`product_id` = `r_product`.`id` WHERE `book_stocks`.`publish` IN (?) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM books AS `books__1` WHERE `books__1`.`id` = `book_stocks`.`book_id` AND (`public_listing` IN (?))) ORDER BY `book_stocks`.`id` DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 20
